notes: The Hardy-Weinberg square is a KYP adaptation preserving the source's 2×2 gamete-combination layout (A(p)/a(q) axes, AA p², Aa pq ×2, aa q²) with the equations, assumptions strip, and the CF worked example. The café-au-lait photograph is an original KYP schematic redraw (pattern-preserving: torso outline, unilateral large light-brown macules with ragged edges respecting the midline, plus the McCune-Albright vs NF1 border contrast and the somatic-vs-germline mosaicism definition panel) — the diagnostic pattern is preserved without reproducing the clinical photograph. The PWS-vs-AS table is implemented as the note's compare block (terminology-level summary; the full mechanism deep-dive lives in the imprinting-disorders note, which owns the same-page imprinting figure).
